People: Zsigmond Kemény (author, Wikidata Q427079), died 1875; Ödön Tull (illustrator, Wikidata Q4465140), died 1911. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Kemény, Zsigmond, báró, 1814-1875; Tull, Ödön, 1870-1911 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Magyar regényirók képes kiadása. Szerkesztette és bevezetésekkel ellátta Mikszáth Kálmán, Budapest Franklin-Társulat, 1911, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/magyarregnyir19miksuoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 72%, 69%, 69% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Ödön Tull, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
